about.title: Who We Are

We are an Egyptian company specialized in software development, web design and development, mobile applications, and AI solutions, delivering comprehensive tech services for companies and entrepreneurs across all industries.

privacy.intro: At ENS Egypt, we are committed to protecting the privacy of our clients and website visitors, and we handle personal data responsibly and transparently. This policy explains how information is collected, used, and protected when you use our website or services.

sections.title: How We Use Information
sections.body: We use the data we collect in order to:
items: Respond to inquiries and contact requests.
Improve website performance and user experience.
Send updates or offers related to our services (with user consent when required).
Protect the website from misuse or unlawful activity.
Comply with legal and regulatory obligations.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: The website may use cookies to improve user experience, analyze website performance, and remember certain settings. Users may disable cookies through their browser settings, noting that some website features may be affected.

sections.title: Sharing Information
sections.body: We do not sell, rent, or trade users' personal data. We may share certain data in the following cases:
items: With service providers who help us operate the website or deliver services, subject to their obligation to keep the data confidential.
When there is a legal obligation or an order issued by a competent judicial or governmental authority.
To protect the rights of the company or users, or to prevent fraud or misuse.

sections.title: Data Protection
sections.body: We take appropriate technical and administrative measures to protect personal data from unauthorized access, loss, alteration, or unlawful disclosure. Nevertheless, no data transmission over the internet can be guaranteed 100% secure.

sections.title: Data Retention
sections.body: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, or as required by applicable laws and regulations.

sections.title: User Rights
sections.body: Subject to applicable laws, users may request to:
items: Correct inaccurate data or update it.
Request deletion of data where legally possible.
Object to certain forms of data processing or request restriction.
Withdraw consent to data processing where processing is based on consent.

sections.title: Children's Privacy
sections.body: Our services are not directed to children below the age defined by local laws, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from them. If we become aware that such data has been collected, we will take appropriate steps to delete it.

sections.title: Privacy Policy Updates
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time to reflect legal, technical, or operational developments. Any update will be published on this page with a revised last-updated date.
